bias.label: Leaning down below 3,500; 3,400 is the next big test

event: Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut, thin trade. Fri 27 Nov: US stocks close early. Mon 30 Nov: COMEX December first notice day. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Fresh 15-month low
bullets.text: Spot gold fell to about 3,446, down 3.1%, by late US morning, its lowest since September 2025 (exact time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hot US data
bullets.text: Core PCE rose to 3.3% y/y against 3.2% expected, and Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%.

bullets.title: Hike nearly certain
bullets.text: Markets price about 96-98% odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December, and about 60% for another in January (sources differ).

bullets.title: Dollar near highs
bullets.text: The dollar index traded around 103.5-104 near its 20-month high, while the US 10-year yield eased to about 4.84%.

bullets.title: Forced selling
bullets.text: A tech stock selloff, margin calls and a CME margin rise on gold futures (5% to 6%) are pushing traders to sell gold for cash.

bullets.title: Flows mixed
bullets.text: Gold ETFs lost about 20 tonnes last week, but central banks keep buying, with China adding for a 24th month in October.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: One report says gold bounced off support late in the day (size UNVERIFIED), and with US markets shut Thursday moves can be jumpy.
